text:
emma: Hey — I drafted a "First 2 Weeks" page in my personal workspace and wanted to share with new PMs. Should I move it to Product or add it to Playbooks? Unsure about visibility and search indexing.

devex-bot: Quick tip: put canonical onboarding artifacts in the team space or the Onboarding DB so they get indexed and show in the team nav. Personal pages stay private unless moved/shared. See https://redwood.docs/notion-onboarding (internal).

ryan: Product > Playbooks is fine for long-form guides, but short checklists live better in Product > Onboarding DB as templates (so New > choose it). If you want it in both places we usually keep a canonical copy in the DB and a short excerpt in Playbooks that links back.

emma: What's the easiest way to make it show up in the DB picker? I don’t see a "Template" button.

kate: Two quick flows: 1) If you can edit the DB: open the Onboarding DB > New > Templates > + > "Create template from page" and paste the content. 2) If you can't edit the DB: move the page into Product > Team Drafts and file a template-request (https://redwood.workflows/perm-request) with the page link and preferred name and we’ll handle it.

ryan: Naming: use prefix "Template:" then Role and short purpose, e.g. "Template: PM - First2Weeks - 202603". Add tags at the top (plain text lines): Owner: <name>, Role: PM, Audience: NewHire, LastReviewed: YYYY-MM-DD. Those help search + our eval scripts.

emma: Do we prefer copying the content into the template or moving the whole page? I want to keep my personal copy.

kate: Copy into the DB template is preferred — that keeps your personal copy and creates the canonical DB entry. If you accidentally move it, you can duplicate it back to your personal workspace before handing off.

infra-bot: Reminder: pages containing customer logs, credentials, or PII must NOT be added to public team spaces. Tag as "sensitive" and use the secure-template-request flow: https://redwood.workflows/secure-template-request.

emma: Are there any formatting rules? I used toggles and a few embeds.

kate: Toggles are fine. Avoid embedding private links that require additional perms. For checklists use plain checkbox blocks so the DB templates can be reused. If you have code snippets, wrap them in a code block with the language.

ryan: One more ops note: add the label "add-to-digest" in the template request if you want the weekly New Hire Digest to include it. We review digest candidates every Monday.

emma: Thanks — I'll create a copy, add the frontmatter, and submit the template-request. cc @ryan for the DB step.

kate: If the template-request form errors, ping me and I can create the template manually. Also we'll periodically consolidate duplicates during quarterly cleanups. :sparkles:
